_comment: Instance families for each Batch execution pathway, read by
ensure_campaign_infra.sh and ensure_analysis_infra.ps1 so the two
platforms cannot drift. Every list is deliberately mixed-family and
mixed-size: a Spot pool with one instance type is the pool most likely
to be unavailable. Sizes are all >= the largest single job in the
pathway, and Batch packs several jobs per instance when they fit.
arm64 needs an arm64 image (docker buildx --platform linux/arm64) and
the ECS_AL2023_ARM64 AMI; x86_64 is the default because the ECR images

abm_campaign._comment: 1 vCPU / 2048 MiB shards, compute-bound: c-family is 2 GiB/vCPU, so a shard fills a core without stranding memory.

analysis_compute._comment: CmdStan fits, up to 16 vCPU / 30 GiB (one chain per vCPU). Bottleneck is core count.

analysis_memory._comment: Surface/bundle aggregation: few cores, whole campaign frame resident. Bottleneck is agent-array/frame size, so r-family at 8 GiB/vCPU.
